composition_contract.foreground: presenter plus hero product, natural hands and strong eye contact
composition_contract.midground: active open PC build, product box or secondary comparison prop, desk surface and practical tools
composition_contract.background: layered hardware shelving, GPU/component silhouettes, acoustic treatment and colored practical lights
composition_contract.depth: clear overlap, scale change, focused foreground and readable environmental storytelling
composition_contract.density: at least five coherent non-text visual anchors distributed across at least six of nine grid regions

shared_constraints: Use an original fictional presenter who resembles no real person. Preserve a true 9:16 portrait canvas, natural five-finger hands and believable product geometry. Keep only compact calm patches where deterministic overlays will be added later; do not simplify the whole set into empty negative space. No readable text, UI, comments, counters, prices, product card, buttons, logos or watermark.

variants.prompt: Create a high-density photorealistic PC-hardware live-commerce clean plate. FOREGROUND: a charismatic fictional East Asian technology host with direct eye contact presents a flagship graphics card close to camera. MIDGROUND: an active open white PC build, light-oak desk, product box silhouette, compact tools and a second comparison component. BACKGROUND: layered GPU and component shelving, acoustic panels, one small plant and restrained emerald/cyan practical lights. Preserve clear foreground, midground and background depth; distribute coherent hardware and studio anchors across at least six areas of the frame. The set should feel busy, premium and actively used, not like a portrait against an empty wall.
